artifact_scope: These definitions describe measurement corrections to saved responses. This package regenerates aggregate reports; it does not redistribute the execution harness, grading implementation, or individual response records.
attribution: Score changes reflect corrected measurement of saved outputs, not new model performance, prompt tuning, or independent human adjudication.
comparison: Keep GPT-4.1 omitted versus GPT-5.6 none separate from low/high sensitivity; do not pool repeated stages.
denominators: Every planned full-stage observation remains included; noncompleted responses receive no task-success credit.
math_rules: Keep the final boxed-answer extraction for MATH-500.
Recognize complete thousands-separated numbers without treating them as lists.
Preserve nonempty textual answers; never delete arbitrary text commands.
Compare numeric arithmetic and square roots with a bounded non-executing AST interpreter, Decimal precision 120 and absolute/relative tolerance 1e-70.
Arithmetic limits: 512 expression characters, 96 tokens/AST nodes, nesting at most 20, literal length 40, integer exponent magnitude at most 12, intermediate magnitude at most 1e30.
Preserve exact normalized symbolic/base-notation matches; flag unsupported nonmatching expressions without granting success.
Treat explicit sets and bare multi-answer lists as unordered; preserve order for explicit tuples and bracketed lists.
Recognize valid ordinal suffixes only in grade questions.
Allow trailing noun/unit phrases only when their words occur in the task context; reject qualifiers and conflicting explicit units.

Decode AIME presentation wrappers, select the last declared final-answer line or terminal boxed answer, and require a complete integer token from 0 through 999, without decimal truncation or last-number guessing.
reference_change: Only supplier/customer address newline-to-comma substitutions introduced by compact invoice rendering; require the corrected reference to occur in the source input.
